Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding {W} for each other creature you control
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Halo Fountain.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, untapping Brigid and untapping Formidable Speaker, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Formidable Speaker by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Halo Fountain.

512-7203-7775.notes: You may start with less creatures, but will need generic mana and possibly {W} as appropriate until you control six or less creatures. While steps 4 and 5 are optional, they will lead to Brigid creating far more mana than would happen otherwise.

250-779-1479-5411-8293.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-8293.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5411-8293.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
